review_text: We recently gave Cafè Ficus a try on a Sunday around noon. They were not too busy and the place was clean and inviting and we were welcomed by the staff. We found a table and were brought menus. We ordered an Iced Seasalt Latte, Biscoff Cookie Frappe, Bacon and Cheese Omelette, and a Chocolate Crepe. Our coffees were made just as we expected and hoped being flavorful, smooth and not too sweet. We were both impressed with the Chocolate Crepe and the omelette was good as well. Overall we had a good experience here and they also have WiFi and the CR was clean.

Can't count how many cafés had occupied this space before it came to be what it is now, Café Ficus. So it's apt to say I had been to almost every one café or tenant. (Seemed that Samz de Cafe was the latest)….Some parking available. It'd just passed its one-month opening. Clean, spacious, and menu had positive choices. It took a while for the meal to be out. Sikwate was familiar and just a diversion to my usual coffee run….A quiet morning was how it went. I'd come back for sure….
Conveniently situated along Roxas night market, decent drinks selection. We had hot beverage as we just had dinner. Courteous staff, airy, cozy cafe.
This lovely cafe is one of the first I have seen to get in on the biscoff bubble. They're biscoff blended coffee and crepes are fantastic. So good that I am glad I don't live closer!!
